option_relations.rationale: Malignant catatonia is a severe form of catatonia, distinct from hypokalemic paralysis.
Catatonia secondary to psychiatric disorder is a mental health condition, not directly related to hypokalemic paralysis.
Catatonia (Catatonic Syndrome) is a neuropsychiatric syndrome, not directly related to hypokalemic paralysis.

Schizophrenia with catatonic features and chronic intestinal pseudo-obstruction (CIPO) describes a psychiatric disorder and a gastrointestinal condition, neither of which is directly equivalent to hypokalemic paralysis.
